description: This file contains a Swift module for transcoding JPEG images, including error handling, image processing, and quality/dimension adjustments. It defines an enum for errors and a struct with static methods to transcode images, potentially downscaling and compressing images to meet size constraints.

classes.name: JPEGTranscodeError
classes.description: An enum representing possible errors during JPEG transcoding, including decode failure, missing properties, encode failure, and size limit exceeded.

classes.name: JPEGTranscoder
classes.description: A struct providing static methods for transcoding images to JPEG format, adjusting quality and size constraints.

methods.name: clampQuality
methods.description: Clamps a quality value between 0.05 and 1.0.

methods.name: transcodeToJPEG
methods.description: Main method for encoding image data to JPEG, with optional resizing to fit within a maximum width and size constraints. Handles image decoding, property reading, thumbnail creation, quality adjustment, and error handling.
